The Linux4.BE distribution

Linux4BE Bootloader and kernel - Experimental (use at your own risk, 800.863 bytes)

Once we have a correct booting system, preparing a complete distro will be the first priority (even before getting a GUI to work). We hope to get as many people on board as soon as possible by providing easy access to a complete system.

The future Linux4.BE Distro will include:

  • A pre-compiled kernel an root filesystem.
  • A packaged toolchain to develop/port your own apps.
